tests.text: [a quiet sigh first, then speaking very slowly and softly to his late wife's photo, aching longing, voice low and tender, a long pause after the first word] …여보. …그 청년, 아직 그 방에 있소.
[a soft chuckle under his breath, gruff but deeply warm, quiet proud smile in the voice, unhurried] …잘 먹었으면 됐네.
[startled and breathless, sitting up suddenly, voice weak from fever but rising with disbelief, trailing off unfinished] …자네가… 여길, 어떻게…
[a long heavy silence first, then barely above a whisper, voice low and cracking slightly, an old man holding back seven years of grief] …집사람… 겁니다.
[calm but heavy with old grief, very slow, a quiet breath at each pause, humble and steady] 칠 년 전에… 먼저 걸던 사람이오. …나는, 이어서 걸었을 뿐이고.
[voice thick with quiet emotion, a gentle fatherly smile audible, seeing him off with pride, half-beat pause after the first word] …그래. …잘 다녀오게.
